about_the_game:
[Dynamic Martial Arts] adopts a fully free combat control system, giving the weapon control rights back to the player completely!

• Dynamic weapon control:

Every attack is controlled by you - freely adjust the attack angle, force and rhythm, perform coherent sword moves or unexpected deadly slashes. Weapons are no longer just button commands, but an extension of your arms.

• Real physical blocking:

Is the enemy's blade coming? Raise your sword to block, dodge sideways, or use the force to rebound! The system instantly determines the direction of weapon collision and force. Whether the block is successful or not depends on your reaction and skills, not numerical probability.

• Ever-changing offensive and defensive strategies:

Combining light and heavy attacks, charging to break defense, feints to lure the enemy, and even disarming the opponent. Environmental interactive elements add depth - kick up sand to dazzle the eyes, use the wall to rebound the knife, and create your own martial arts skills.

• Unfettered martial arts styles: From the swift one-handed rapier to the wild dual-wielding greataxe, each weapon brings a completely different feel and combo possibilities. After learning the inner strength, you can even use your true energy to penetrate the blade, achieving the shocking effect of injuring the enemy from a distance or repelling thousands of troops.
